lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs2Zn5I11 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell (Cs8Zn20I44) and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Zn centers as octahedrally coordinated by six I neighbors (Zn–I distances 2.83–3.15 Å) and Cs centers in a close-packed-like arrangement with twelve I neighbors (3.21–3.46 Å). Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Zn octahedra sharing corners and edges, while Cs 12-vertex polyhedra share faces with Zn octahedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
